name: AUDIT-RPT1026-H1-sheet-unread
old:
if (sheetReadTasks(quest).has(no.symbol.name)) return null;
  return timesNamed(quest, no.symbol.name) === 1 ? no : null;
note: A No the questlines' sheet reads is forgotten a tick after it is said: N0B00Y09 ends loyal for refused, $CUREWER failed for spared.

name: AUDIT-RPT1026-H1-stamp-unread
note: DFU's own quest (the questlines off) reads a sheet it never had: its four Nos stop asking again.

name: AUDIT-RPT1026-H1-outcomes-unread
old:
for (const o of sheet.outcomes ?? []) walk(o.on);
  for (const b of sheet.branches ?? [])
note: An ending the sheet binds to a No is not a read: $CUREWER's spared.

name: AUDIT-RPT1026-H1-objectives-unread
note: An objective the sheet strikes on a No is not a read: 80C0XY00's kept secret.

name: AUDIT-RPT1026-H1-nested-unread
old:
for (const k of ['all', 'any']) if (Array.isArray(b[k])) for (const x of b[k]) walk(x);
    if (b.not) walk(b.not);
note: A No named inside a binding's any or all is not a read.

name: AUDIT-RPT1026-H2-classic-words-dropped
note: The classic skin's close names a Quests tab its pause window does not have.

name: AUDIT-RPT1026-H4-unwritten-on-every-row
note: A stamped quest whose objectives fill its page is said to have nothing written.

name: AUDIT-RPT1026-H4-gives-any-get-item
old:
if (!no.actions.every((/** @type {any} */ a) => a.typeName === 'GetItem' && toted.has(a.itemSymbol?.name)))
    return null;
note: A No that hands back an item its click never toted asks again.

name: AUDIT-RPT1026-H4-gives-named-elsewhere
old:
if (sheetReadTasks(quest).has(no.symbol.name)) return null;
  return timesNamed(quest, no.symbol.name) === 1 ? no : null;
note: A No something else in the script reads is forgotten as if nothing did.

name: AUDIT-RPT1026-H4-beside-second-ring-dropped
note: A Person whose first ring is full stands inside someone instead of a step further out.
